summary: Katapult Holdings' wholly owned subsidiary CCF OpCo LLC entered a Seventh Amendment to its Second Amended and Restated Revolving Credit Agreement dated December 29, 2023, extending the Draw Period Termination Date from September 30, 2026 to November 30, 2026, subject to earlier termination on an unwaived Cease Funding Event. Concurrently, Huntington National Bank resigned as administrative agent and assigned that role to Sunflower Bank, N.A. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation; watch liquidity and potential twelve-month amortization if the draw period ends without extension.
